title: Wind Turbine Service Technicians
description: Inspect, diagnose, adjust, or repair wind turbines. Perform maintenance on wind turbine equipment including resolving electrical, mechanical, and hydraulic malfunctions.

tasks.text: Troubleshoot or repair mechanical, hydraulic, or electrical malfunctions related to variable pitch systems, variable speed control systems, converter systems, or related components.
tasks.rationale: decision support — Troubleshooting aided; hands-on diagnosis human

dwas.name: Troubleshoot equipment or systems operation problems.
Repair green energy equipment or systems.

tasks.text: Perform routine maintenance on wind turbine equipment, underground transmission systems, wind fields substations, or fiber optic sensing and control systems.
tasks.rationale: physical manipulation — Physical maintenance of machinery

tasks.text: Diagnose problems involving wind turbine generators or control systems.
tasks.rationale: physical manipulation — Physical repair of installed energy systems

dwas.name: Repair green energy equipment or systems.

tasks.text: Test electrical components of wind systems with devices, such as voltage testers, multimeters, oscilloscopes, infrared testers, or fiber optic equipment.
tasks.rationale: physical manipulation — Electrical probing and meter work by hand

dwas.name: Test electrical circuits or components for proper functioning.

tasks.text: Start or restart wind turbine generator systems to ensure proper operations.
tasks.rationale: physical manipulation — Hands-on mechanical testing in physical environment

dwas.name: Test mechanical equipment to ensure proper functioning.

tasks.text: Climb wind turbine towers to inspect, maintain, or repair equipment.
tasks.rationale: situated mobility — Climbing structures requires physical mobility

dwas.name: Climb equipment or structures to access work areas.

tasks.text: Maintain tool and spare parts inventories required for repair, installation, or replacement services.
tasks.rationale: data analysis — Materials inventory records and forecasting automatable

dwas.name: Maintain inventories of materials, equipment, or products.

tasks.text: Test structures, controls, or mechanical, hydraulic, or electrical systems, according to test plans or in coordination with engineers.
tasks.rationale: data analysis — Electrical testing requires hands-on instrument use

dwas.name: Test electrical equipment or systems to ensure proper functioning.
Test mechanical systems to ensure proper functioning.

tasks.text: Train end-users, distributors, installers, or other technicians in wind commissioning, testing, or other technical procedures.
tasks.rationale: interpersonal — Operational training requires live human delivery

dwas.name: Train customers in the use of products.

tasks.text: Collect turbine data for testing or research and analysis.
tasks.rationale: physical manipulation — Requires physical gauges and instrument reading

tasks.text: Inspect or repair fiberglass turbine blades.
tasks.rationale: visual inspection — Locating wear and damage requires physical inspection

dwas.name: Inspect mechanical equipment to locate damage, defects, or wear.
Repair green energy equipment or systems.

tasks.text: Assist in assembly of individual wind generators or construction of wind farms.
tasks.rationale: physical manipulation — Assembling structural components is hands-on
